Ladner Townhomes: streets and boundaries

items.t: Ladner's townhouses sit in Neilsen Grove (Admiral Way, Ferry Road) and on central streets around Central Avenue, 57 Street and 60B Street.
Neilsen Grove is the area; its school is Neilson Grove Elementary, which Polygon says buyers can walk to.
East Ladner's growth is on 60B Street, in the Ladner East-Urban (LV4) development permit area.

blocks.text: Ladner Townhomes: the housing stock

items.t: Hampton Cove is Polygon's master-planned townhouse community in Neilsen Grove; its Hampton Club is a private clubhouse over 12,000 square feet.
Westhampton at Hampton Cove is three- and four-bedroom townhouses at 5510 Admiral Way.
Central Ladner's newer form is three storeys, as in the two-building East Ladner proposal.

blocks.text: Ladner Townhomes: rules that affect buyers

items.t: A Ladner East-Urban (LV4) development permit controls form and character for new East Ladner townhouses.
Density there is site-specific: proposed Comprehensive Development Zone 65 (CDZ65) would permit three storeys at floor space ratio 1.25.
On 57 Street the zone was Townhouse Residential 62 (RT62) under Delta Zoning Bylaw No. 7600, 2017.

blocks.text: Ladner Townhomes: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: The Hampton Club's guest suites serve residents' visitors, an amenity smaller central complexes lack.
Polygon places Hampton Cove between a golf course and a marina on the Millennium Trail.
The 60B Street site is 16 units in two three-storey buildings.
East Ladner feedback closed October 30, 2025, before Council saw the application, so renderings are not approved.
Delta Secondary, 4615 51 Street, serves Ladner townhouse addresses.

blocks.text: Ladner Townhomes: getting around

items.t: Route 618, the Ladner North loop, runs via Harvest Drive, Ladner Trunk Road, Central Avenue and Ferry Road; peak riders are pointed to routes 606 and 608.
Route 601 connects Ladner Exchange to Bridgeport Station via Highway 99.

A lot within 30 metres of a ditch or slough is in the Streamside Protection and Enhancement Development Permit Area.

Ladner townhomes: what sold, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026

62 townhomes sold in Ladner with a median price of $890,000 (the middle half sold between $838,075 and $1,051,250), taking a median of 38 days to sell at 97.4% of the last list price; 8% sold above list. They had a median $588 per square foot, a median year built of 2010 and a median strata fee of $432 a month.

blocks.text: Ladner townhomes against Tsawwassen and North Delta

The 62 Ladner townhomes sold at a $890,000 median, the highest of the three Delta areas: $85,000 above North Delta ($805,000, 43 sales) and $122,550 above Tsawwassen ($767,450, 60 sales). Ladner was also the slowest, at 38 days to sell against 21 in North Delta and 35 in Tsawwassen. The median build year of 2010 sits next to North Delta's 2009 and well behind Tsawwassen's 2020, and strata fees fall between the other two at $432 a month, $5,184 a year or 0.58% of the median price.

blocks.text: 33 of the 62 Ladner sales, 53%, fell between $800,000 and $999,999, and a further 9 between $1,000,000 and $1,199,999. 7 sold between $1,200,000 and $1,499,999. A buyer with a budget under $800,000 had 13 sales to choose from over the 12 months. Median per-square-foot prices were $588 in Ladner, $548 in Tsawwassen and $493 in North Delta.
